surfaces.label: POST /generate — SAT question generation endpoint
surfaces.trigger: HTTP POST request with InceptBench-compatible JSON body and optional Bearer token or X-API-Key header
surfaces.observed_outcome: Runs the generation pipeline via asyncio.gather, produces a SAT math question with assets, stores results in GCS, and returns the generated question JSON
surfaces.notes: Auth is optional: if SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN env var is unset the endpoint is open (local dev mode)

surfaces.label: GET /generate — endpoint contract summary
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /generate
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns a JSON summary describing the POST /generate contract including supported parameters, for callers to inspect before running batch requests

surfaces.label: GET /health — main API health check
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /health
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns a JSON health status response indicating the service is running

surfaces.label: GET / — main API root welcome response
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns a root JSON welcome/info response from the main FastAPI application

surfaces.label: GET /browse — GCS bucket browser HTML page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /browse or /browse/{prefix:path}
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page via Jinja2 templates listing GCS bucket objects and directories at the given prefix, allowing navigation of stored question assets

surfaces.label: GET /object/{key} — GCS object proxy download
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /object/{key:path}
surfaces.observed_outcome: Streams the raw GCS object bytes back to the caller with appropriate content-type headers, acting as a proxy for stored assets

surfaces.label: GET /image/{key} — image asset HTML viewer page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /image/{key:path}
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page displaying a GCS-stored image asset (PNG/SVG) with navigation back to the parent browse directory

surfaces.label: GET /view/{key} — Markdown article HTML viewer page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /view/{key:path}
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page displaying a Markdown article fetched from GCS, with parent directory navigation breadcrumbs

surfaces.label: POST /convert — SVG to PNG conversion microservice endpoint
surfaces.trigger: HTTP POST request with SVG content (raw body or JSON) to the svg-to-image microservice on port 8002
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders the SVG to a PNG image using Playwright/Chromium and returns the PNG bytes

surfaces.label: GET /health — svg-to-image microservice health check
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /health on the svg-to-image microservice
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns JSON health status indicating the svg-to-image service is alive

surfaces.label: svg-to-image convert — single SVG file to PNG conversion CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `svg-to-image convert <INPUT> <OUTPUT>` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Converts a single SVG file (or stdin) to a PNG file using Playwright/Chromium headless rendering

surfaces.label: svg-to-image convert-batch — batch SVG directory to PNG conversion CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `svg-to-image convert-batch <INPUT_DIR>` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Converts all SVG files in a directory to PNG files, writing output alongside or to a specified root directory

surfaces.label: svg-to-image serve — start svg-to-image HTTP microservice
surfaces.trigger: Running `svg-to-image serve` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Starts the svg-to-image FastAPI web server on the configured host/port (default 8002) for handling POST /convert requests

surfaces.label: POST /render — SVG generation from scene description microservice endpoint
surfaces.trigger: HTTP POST request with a scene JSON body to the svg-gen microservice on port 8001
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an SVG diagram from a structured scene description using the svg-gen generation pipeline

surfaces.label: POST /image/fromQuestion — generate SVG image from question data
surfaces.trigger: HTTP POST request with question data JSON to /image/fromQuestion on the svg-gen microservice
surfaces.observed_outcome: Generates an SVG image asset from a SAT math question object and returns the rendered SVG

surfaces.label: svg-gen render — generate SVG from a scene description CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `svg-gen render` with a scene description string or file path on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Generates an SVG file from the given scene description using the LLM-backed rendering pipeline and writes to stdout or a file

surfaces.label: svg-gen serve — start svg-gen HTTP microservice
surfaces.trigger: Running `svg-gen serve` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Starts the svg-gen FastAPI web server on port 8001 for handling POST /render requests

surfaces.label: POST /generate — image-gen microservice image generation endpoint
surfaces.trigger: HTTP POST request with a prompt JSON body to the image-gen microservice on port 8003
surfaces.observed_outcome: Generates a PNG image from the given text prompt using the OpenAI image generation API and returns the image bytes

surfaces.label: image-gen generate — generate an image from a text prompt CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `image-gen generate <prompt>` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Generates a PNG image from the text prompt via OpenAI and writes to a file or stdout

surfaces.label: image-gen serve — start image-gen HTTP microservice
surfaces.trigger: Running `image-gen serve` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Starts the image-gen FastAPI web server on port 8003 for handling POST /generate image requests

surfaces.label: GET /api/topics — question bank fetcher topic listing API
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /api/topics on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns a JSON list of all available SAT topic bundles grouped by assessment type

surfaces.label: GET /api/topic/{slug} — question bank fetcher topic detail API
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /api/topic/{slug} on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns JSON with the full question bundle for the given topic slug including questions and metadata

surfaces.label: question-bank-fetcher download — download SAT question bank CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `question-bank-fetcher download` with options for assessment, domain, output directory, etc.
surfaces.observed_outcome: Fetches SAT question bundles from the InceptCurriculum API and saves them as JSON files to the local data directory

surfaces.label: question-bank-fetcher serve — start question bank local HTTP server
surfaces.trigger: Running `question-bank-fetcher serve` with a data directory path on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Starts a local FastAPI server on port 8765 exposing downloaded question bank data via REST API

surfaces.label: GET / — question viewer HTML root page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to / on the question-viewer server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page for viewing SAT math questions with their SVG/HTML assets server-side

surfaces.label: question-viewer serve — start question viewer HTTP server
surfaces.trigger: Running `question-viewer serve` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Starts a local FastAPI server on port 7890 for viewing rendered SAT math questions as HTML

surfaces.label: gcs-uploader upload — upload a file to GCS CLI
surfaces.trigger: Running `gcs-uploader upload <FILE_PATH> --destination <GCS_PATH>` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Uploads a local file to the specified GCS bucket path with optional content-type override

surfaces.label: GET /health — svg-gen microservice health check
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /health on the svg-gen microservice
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns JSON health status indicating the svg-gen service is alive

surfaces.label: GET /health — image-gen microservice health check
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /health on the image-gen microservice
surfaces.observed_outcome: Returns JSON health status indicating the image-gen service is alive

surfaces.label: GET / — question bank fetcher HTML index page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to / on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page listing all available SAT topic bundles grouped by assessment type, with links to each topic page

surfaces.label: GET /topic/{slug} — question bank fetcher topic HTML detail page
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /topic/{slug} on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Renders an HTML page showing the full question bundle for the given topic slug, including all questions and their metadata

surfaces.label: GET /pdf/{slug} — question bank fetcher topic PDF inline view
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /pdf/{slug} on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Serves the topic PDF file as an inline response (displayed in browser)

surfaces.label: GET /pdf/{slug}/download — question bank fetcher topic PDF file download
surfaces.trigger: HTTP GET request to /pdf/{slug}/download on the question-bank-fetcher server
surfaces.observed_outcome: Serves the topic PDF as a file attachment (triggers browser download)

surfaces.label: sync_sat_to_gcs.py — bulk sync SAT curricula directory to GCS
surfaces.trigger: Running `python scripts/sync_sat_to_gcs.py [--dry-run]` on the command line
surfaces.observed_outcome: Walks the local curricula/SAT/ directory and uploads all files to the GCS bucket using GcsUploader, making them visible via the /browse, /object, /image, and /view surfaces
